import { z } from "zod/v4";

import { leftSchema, nodeSchema, rightSchema } from "./safe-explicit";
import type { Left, Node, Right } from "./safe-explicit";

type Equal<TLeft, TRight> = (<T>() => T extends TLeft ? 1 : 2) extends <T>() =>
  T extends TRight ? 1 : 2
  ? true
  : false;
type Assert<TValue extends true> = TValue;

type ExpectedNode = { value: string; children: ExpectedNode[] };
type ExpectedLeft = { name: string; right: ExpectedRight };
type ExpectedRight = { count: number; left?: ExpectedLeft | undefined };

export type NodeSchemaOutputIsRecursive = Assert<
  Equal<z.output<typeof nodeSchema>, ExpectedNode>
>;
export type NodeAliasIsRecursive = Assert<Equal<Node, ExpectedNode>>;
export type LeftSchemaOutputIsRecursive = Assert<
  Equal<z.output<typeof leftSchema>, ExpectedLeft>
>;
export type RightSchemaOutputIsRecursive = Assert<
  Equal<z.output<typeof rightSchema>, ExpectedRight>
>;
export type LeftAliasIsRecursive = Assert<Equal<Left, ExpectedLeft>>;
export type RightAliasIsRecursive = Assert<Equal<Right, ExpectedRight>>;
